title: Assert servlet redirect and forward destinations with Ant patterns
summary: The new MockMvc matchers accepted the intended redirect and forward. A single star rejected the extra path segment and a double star accepted it.

change.description: Two new MockMvcResultMatchers factories accept Ant patterns while the existing exact URL assertions retain literal semantics. The comparison uses the merge commit and its first parent.

notes: A separate exact forward assertion retained its literal question mark. The caller checked the actual dispatched destination before applying each matcher.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-test-4.0.0.M3-q19. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
